tweetMedia.transcription: They unlocked the ATM, opened it, then closed it again, without taking any money. But, hours later, they came back. One man stood in front, holding up his phone, and the ATM suddenly started dumping cash. You see, they had secretly installed software that let them take control. So, when the phone sent the signal, the ATM thought it was being told to pay out. The machine spit out bills until about $175,000 was gone. And even though the whole thing was caught on camera, the thieves were never identified.
